2026 Annual Conference

October 18-21, 2026  |  Grand Hyatt Nashville

REGISTER NOW

Advancing Tax. Together. 

The 2026 TEI Annual Conference agenda builds on the strong foundation of past annual conference programs, bringing together practical insights, timely technical content, and real-world perspectives for in-house tax professionals. The conference theme Advancing Tax. Together. is designed to encourage collaboration, shared learning, and meaningful conversation across the tax community to advance the tax profession.

The program features plenary sessions on the broader tax landscape alongside concurrent breakouts that allow attendees to tailor their experience, with a focus on emerging issues and practical application. Content covers key developments in federal, international, SALT, as well as tax technology, financial reporting, and legislative updates. Sessions will also address tax leadership and professional development, emerging issues for tax executives, and cross-border considerations.

 NEW! in Nashville. Following the highly successful rollout of the TEI Tax Labs at the Midyear Conference, these interactive, hands‑on sessions will return in Nashville. Tax Labs offer a collaborative, small-group environment focused on practical application and peer‑driven discussion of complex tax technology issues led by leading providers in the space.

More than a Conference. An Experience.

The learning doesn't stop when the sessions end. From can’t-miss networking receptions and celebrations to exclusive Nashville experiences, TEI's Special Events offer the perfect way to connect with peers, strengthen professional relationships, and make the most of your time in Music City. Whether you're looking to expand your network, reconnect with colleagues, or simply enjoy some of Nashville's best attractions, these events are designed to bring the TEI community together in memorable ways. Space is limited for select events, so be sure to reserve your spot early. Explore the special events.

Why Attend

Expert-Led Sessions That Matter
Discover the latest developments in all major tax practice areas with plenary and concurrent sessions designed to keep you ahead in a changing environment. Past conferences have delivered rich content on emerging tax challenges, digital transformation, and compliance trends — and 2026 will continue that momentum. 

 

A Powerful Community of In‑House Professionals & Networking
TEI’s Annual Conference remains a central hub for the in-house tax community — a place where professionals at every stage can exchange ideas, gain practical insights, and strengthen their network with peers who understand the real-world challenges of corporate tax. 

 

 

Technology Focus, Solutions & TEI Tax Labs
Engage with TEI’s industry-leading sponsors and technology providers who help drive innovation across the tax function. From solution showcases to collaborative discussions, this is your chance to explore tools and strategies that elevate your tax team’s impact. NEW! in Nashville will be TEI’s Tax Labs featuring multiple interactive sessions tackling real-world tax tech challenges.

 

Experience Nashville
Set against the backdrop of Music City, this year’s conference blends TEI’s signature programming with the energy, culture, and hospitality that make Nashville one of the nation’s most celebrated destinations. Enjoy top-tier learning by day and world‑class entertainment, cuisine, and local experiences by night. TEI’s Tuesday Night Gala will be a true Music City blowout!

 

 

 

Who Should Attend?

In-house tax professionals across all tax practice areas, including federal, international, state & local, and financial reporting

Chief Tax Officers (CTOs) and senior tax leaders responsible for strategy, compliance, and risk management

Tax department managers and directors looking to stay current on regulatory changes and best practices

Tax technology professionals with responsibilities in AI, data analytics, and digital transformation in tax functions

Professionals involved in IRS interactions, audits, and administrative processes

Individuals focused on tax policy, planning, and emerging legislative developments

Early-career tax professionals and first-time attendees seeking networking and professional development opportunities

Any tax professional looking to strengthen leadership, communication, and talent development skills within their organization

Learning Objectives

Analyze recent tax legislation, regulatory developments, and their practical implications for corporate taxpayers

Evaluate emerging IRS policies, administrative trends, and audit strategies to better manage tax risk

Apply insights from federal, international, and state & local tax updates to real-world business scenarios

Explore the impact of technology, data analytics, and AI on modernizing tax functions and improving efficiency

Identify planning opportunities and risks related to transactions, credits, and cross-border operations

Strengthen approaches to tax reporting, compliance, and financial accounting (e.g., ASC 740 considerations)

Exchange leading practices and peer perspectives to enhance decision-making and tax department performance
